ACTIV

The weakest link in an otherwise really formidable tribe because ironically, he's the person who's the least active in the tribe so far; albeit that's not by a lot considering we're having full fledged conversations including one about our shared Asian roots rn. The only issue really is how fluctuating his activity intervals are which makes him a rather elusive figure to track down. Go figure! Even the easiest looking boot in the tribe is gonna feel sickening in the event that it happens. Says he's good with puzzles so we'll see where he fits in the tribe in the near future. chall skills: puzzles social game: solid enough, publicly the least active positioning/perception/strategy: its still early days; we'll see perception of shinx: so far it seems that we get along but nothing really sticks out with him; i think us being on good terms will definitely help me out in the event of a tribal since i prolly dont get voted on by him. well appreciated for challenge contributions and constant kindness allies: ? important notes: n/a (edited)

S8N

Yeah you can tell this guy has talent and spades of it - one of two clear figureheads for the tribe from a more visible standpoint. Leads challenges, actively involved in VCs, natural air of leadership, he's definitely right there as a top contender on this episode's edgic. I don't really buy his approach of taking the pace of the game casually by not dividing it with alliances - he's definitely got one at minimum with Sam and although he may perceive me as a top 2 ally rn I have to be adaptable and anticipate how far he's willing to take me. If he views me as a non-threat to his game, I should be able to hold on and hold on I will because ORG player from hell might just be my guaranteed ticket to merge if I play my cards right. Especially if he's deploying Sam to earn my trust, given how much in lockstep they are. chall skills: godtier, at least based on my observations. social game: really solid, has ties with seemingly everyone important to the plot. active vc user who's also a genuinely likeable person. one of two leading tribe members pos/per/strat: as aforementioned, strong leadership and top billing in the tribe. recognises this and isnt drawing any lines in the sand and compromising that position. smart. perception of shinx: eager to work as a duo, plays a bit harder than the rest and is pretty neat as a person. #2 behind sam (allegedly) allies: Sam, Ghoody important notes:

Also a liability if he flips, so there's that working against him too... it sucks what I'm gonna have to do next, but it's something that I feel would've always happened regardless. There's bound to be better goats to drag to FTC. chall skills: puzzles.. apparently social game: bottom of the tribe. his own doing. positioning/perception/strategy: aims to just lay back and chill when he's not called to action; unfortunately does not realise how dangerous of a position he is and therefore squandered his trust with multiple people, most notably sam. his laidbackness is not a good fit for what i'm looking for in an ally come the merge. perception of shinx: i'm his last hope... but even his last hope cant save him here. this must be how quack felt trying to save me in koolvivor... allies:

GRACE

A longtime question was answered since: turns out Grace is a superfan, and we've bonded despite me clearly not being a superfan but pretending to be one anyway! She's come a long way from being sussed for being better than she implies to currently my #1 ally (a title that may be ceded to s8n upon merge) and crucially, the Amanda to my Todd. Both equally capable social/strategic powerhouses in a season full of diverse characters. Has clearly got a game of her own and I respect the hell outta that, hopefully we hit FTC together bc we've without a doubt had the most game talk amongst everyone left in the game and it isn't even remotely close. chall skills: alright social game: easily likeable personality. well liked by sam, and is never really in danger of being voted out anytime soon. definite contender. pos/per/strat: comfortable position within the majority alliance, has great levels of trust with everyone and isn't really seen as a target by anyone. has a shocking acumen for strategy and is often the one with the better head when discussing strats perception of shinx: pledged to a ftc pact. definitely a lot more strategic than he lets off but ultimately trustworthy. definitely a threat that needs to be cautionary towards. allies: Sam, Shthe important notes: very power player vibes. she's got a talent for orgs and honestly you love to see it

SAM

Social. powerhouse.
